title: Provenance record
description: FR-056 / FR-018a / FR-018b / FR-044 / FR-060. One record per method per hand-off, returned by the runner. Completeness is machine-checked before admission; a record missing any required field is REFUSED with the missing field named, never accepted with gaps (SC-014). Each field is attributed to the environment that produced it, because under FR-052 the three methods do not share one environment.

method.description: Method name. Matches the adapter registry key.

repository.description: The external repository this result came from. FR-055: nothing from it is vendored, copied, patched or committed in this project.

revision.description: Full 40-character commit SHA. A branch name, tag or short SHA is not a revision and is refused.

checkpoint.description: FR-044. The filename alone is not identity; size_bytes alone is not enough.

identity.description: Checkpoint filename or release artefact name.

sha256.description: sha256 of the checkpoint file as configured. Checked against the identity pinned in configs/dl.json at admission.

code_license.description: Licence of the repository's code. A: MIT. B: GPL-3.0. C: none (no licence published - default copyright, a recorded position, not a missing field).

weight_license.description: Licence of the checkpoint weights, recorded separately from the code licence. The two may differ.

checkpoint_load_evidence.description: FR-018a / FR-018b. POSITIVE evidence that the configured checkpoint was the one loaded - the loaded state's tensor keys and their checksum matched against the configured file. A plausible mask, a correct shape, a correct value range, or 'the code ran without error' is NOT evidence. Method C's upstream code catches the missing-checkpoint error, prints a warning and continues with a randomly initialised decoder producing plausible output, which is exactly what this field exists to catch.

evidenced.description: true only when positive identity evidence was produced and is described in detail. false means the run is inadmissible for this method.

method.description: How the evidence was obtained (e.g. state_dict key set plus checksum comparison).

detail.description: The evidence itself: the observed keys/hash, or the reason evidence could not be produced.

device.description: FR-060. Every timing figure is attributed to its producing device. 'cuda' alone is not sufficient - the specific accelerator name is required, because three methods run on three different machines and their timings are not comparable.

interpreter.description: Interpreter version of the environment that ran this method, recorded per method (FR-044). Method A's pinned fastai 1.0.60 / torch 1.4.0 stack caps at Python 3.7, so the three may legitimately differ.

packages.description: The REAL versions of the environment that ran, not the versions listed in requirements.txt (FR-044).

seed.description: Seed used. Recorded because a method whose preprocessing or inference is stochastic is not reproducible without it.

run_timestamp.description: ISO-8601 timestamp of the run, with offset.

deviation.description: FR-055. A workaround for an upstream defect applied in the runner's OWN environment, recorded as a deviation from the pinned revision. Nothing is patched in this project's tree. A workaround that changes the model's output makes the result a DIFFERENT method, not the pinned one, and is inadmissible as that method.

what.description: What was changed, relative to the pinned revision.

why.description: The upstream defect it works around.

changes_output.description: true when the workaround alters the produced mask (a different threshold, a different preprocessing constant, a re-exported checkpoint). Such a result MUST NOT be reported as the pinned method.
